queries: OpenAI Anthropic 1.3 trillion commitments training costs cancellation 2026

sources_considered.why: Accessible reporting explicitly distinguishes a spending forecast from contractual infrastructure totals. Underlying private planning documents were not available.

Reviewed purchase commitments and individual infrastructure terms. They do not provide a reconciled two-company total at October 6 or establish the effect of training cuts; some disclosures also encompass subsequent amendments.
Reviewed as a research lead, then checked the underlying filing. Its analysis does not supply a causal test for both companies.
Qualitative company statements about efficiency and growth do not measure the cash savings available from reducing training.

evidence_items.explanation: The reported $750 billion figure is planned spending through 2030. A spending projection does not establish an equal amount of unavoidable contractual payments or demonstrate what training cuts would save.

unresolved_gaps: No reconciled $1.3 trillion schedule of relevant obligations at the post date was established.
Training expenditure was not separated into avoidable cash costs, allocated costs and unavoidable capacity payments for both companies.
No causal comparison established the effect of training cuts on funding needs and subsequent growth.
The accounting basis of the claimed commitment total is unspecified.
